source.dataset: NOAA NHC HURDAT2 Atlantic best track
source.note: Bundled with the hurricane_simulator package. Wind radii (34/50/64 kt, per quadrant) recorded from 2004; radius of maximum wind recorded from 2021. Radii are best-track estimates, largest quadrant, converted from nautical miles.

scope: Parameters are constant within each event: evaluated once per storm at its peak-intensity track point. The profile is axisymmetric; forward-motion asymmetry and land effects are not represented.

rmw.form: ln(rmw_km) = intercept + per_kt * max_wind_kt + per_degree_latitude * latitude

outer_decay_exponent.method: median of ln(max_wind_kt / 64) / ln(r64_km / rmw_km) over fixes with both radii

taper.method: median and 90th percentile of the largest-quadrant 34 kt radius of hurricane fixes
